messages:
julia: Quick FYI — post-deploy we've got a spike in console chart paint times, especially heatmap and timeseries. Seeing LCP go from ~1.2s -> 3.8s on EU canary. @kevin can you take a look?

ops-bot: deploy-bot: deployment 2026-03-20T14:05 rolled to canary (routing-quota:weight=0.8) — see https://deploys.internal/12345 :robot_face:

kevin: on it. do you have a repro or recording?

julia: yes — repro user: meera@testacct. recording + perf trace in S3 https://s3.internal/redwood/perf/heatmap-6171234567.trace

meera: I saw that too. It correlates with the routing weight change + kv-cache TTL bump from 60->300s. frontend bundle size didn't change much but we see repeated dataset fetches per tile.

julia: stack sample from trace (simplified): 
```
fetch(/api/datasets/tiles?keys=...) x 12
renderHeatline -> computeLayout -> parseCSV (main thread)
```

kevin: Can you dump network waterfall? suspect duplicate requests due to stale cache header + our route-affinity fallback.

meera: attaching waterfall snippet: repeated 304s, but each tile triggers an XHR because `cache-control: private, max-age=0` being set by proxy.

sam: I pushed a quick client patch to debounce tile fetches for 200ms — https://git.internal/p/patches/456 — canary rolling.

kevin: Nice. Also toggled routing weight back to 0.6 for EU canary at 6171234700; monitor from now.

ops-bot: routing-controller: updated policy canary/eu weight=0.6 by kevin at 6171234700

julia: after revert numbers improved — LCP down to ~1.6s but still 2x baseline on some accounts.

meera: we should add a small server-side header fix — set `cache-control: max-age=300, stale-while-revalidate=30` on tiles and rely on prefix KV cache. I'll open an RFC.

kevin: agreed. Also let's coordinate with platform to add a quota rule to limit concurrent tile fetches per session -> avoid thundering herd.

matthew: can we also add telemetry metric for per-route repeated-304 count? add to console telemetry pipeline (small event: tile_retries).

julia: created a short issue: https://issues.internal/RED-789 throttle client + header fix + metric. Assigning meera + kevin + matthew.

design-ux: noted — UX workaround for slow charts: show skeleton + progressive reveal so slow paint less jarring.

julia: OK cool. Will monitor canary for next 2 hours and then plan small rollout.
